text:
Maya (Sales): ACME legal returned the CAIQ with a few redlines around encryption and key custody. we need concise, copy-pasteable answers + a short demo plan.
Chris (Security): list the asks so we don't miss anything.
Maya (Sales): 1) confirm at-rest encryption algorithm and envelope use, 2) BYOK/customer KMS support for hosted instances, 3) HSM support and attestation, 4) key rotation policy and who enforces, 5) whether Redwood ever holds plaintext keys for recovery.
Aria (Solutions): short answers: AES-256-GCM for data at rest using envelope encryption. Customers may use their KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) or KMIP HSMs for Dedicated/Private. HSMs we support are FIPS validated.
Vik (Infra): implementation note: Hosted BYOK integrates with customer KMS via APIs; we never import unwrapped root keys. For Private, we can point to KMIP or accept wrapped keys. HSM attestation PDFs available pre-POC.
Chris (Security): rotation: if BYOK, rotation is controlled by customer KMS. For Redwood-managed keys, default wrapping-key rotation is 180 days (configurable); high-sensitivity customers can choose 90 days. Data keys are rewrapped automatically during background maintenance. We do not escrow customer root keys.
Jordan (ACME): important: do you ever transmit key material offsite or to third parties?
Aria (Solutions): no. customer key material is never exported in plaintext outside the configured KMS boundary. logs of key operations are recorded and can be exported for Dedicated/Private.
Maya (Sales): legal wants one-sentence contract language we can paste.
Chris (Security): suggested: "Redwood protects customer data at rest with AES-256-GCM using envelope encryption. Customers may supply and retain their own wrapping keys via supported KMS integrations (BYOK); HSM-backed keys are supported and meet FIPS 140-2/3 standards. Redwood does not export customer key material in plaintext and maintains audit logs of key access."
Maya (Sales): perfect. also need a 4-step POC checklist to show we keep customer control.
Vik (Infra): POC checklist: 1) stand up Dedicated/VPC trial, 2) configure customer KMS key or KMIP endpoint, 3) run ingest and show ciphertext + describe-key output, 4) rotate wrapping key in customer KMS and demonstrate seamless rewrap and export attestation PDF.
Jordan (ACME): can we get the attestation before the call?
Vik (Infra): yes, will upload signed attestation to secure link and post here.
ArtifactBot: attestation-upload: https://redwood-secure.s3/attestations/acme-hsm-attest.pdf (expires in 7d) :lock: :white_check_mark:
Maya (Sales): sending this to legal now. tagging @Chris if they push back on wording. :thumbsup:
